sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I2, which must be performed on an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The technical specification of traveling crane 
capacity 32000 kg, span 9300 mm, total weight 9560 kg, speed 20/5 m/min, power 
0.8/0.18 kw

ال 
تم بدء المسودة الأولى واختبارها والموافقة عليها بواسطة المهندس. عبد المحسن محمد 
المدير العام ل

Nag 
Hamady hyd. PS
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued and qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category
Stop the crane and switch off the power supply
Safety fence caution marks surrounding the work area is required

Wear the safety 
 and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ...etc.
